lines.t: Verse 1 —
Lord, I’ve wandered through the noise and endless trying,
Chased the wind and found my soul was tired of fighting.
So I come to You with open hands tonight,
Teach me how to rest and hear Your still small light.
Pre-Chorus —
When my heart is quiet, I feel You near,
In the hush of my spirit, Your voice rings clear.
Chorus —
In the quiet of Your presence, I find my place again,
Breaking bread beside You, freed from every chain.
In Your healing arms I’m whole, in Your peace I’m known—
A desirable union, Lord, I call Your love my home.
Verse 2
You lift the broken pieces, set the weary down,
You crown the lost and lonely with a mercy crown.
Every daughter shining new, every son now found—
In the secret of Your presence, we’re on holy ground.
Bridge —
When the world grows loud, You whisper through the wind,
You remind my soul where forever begins.
You’re the calm my restless spirit’s longed to see,
And in Your will, Lord, I am finally free.
Final Chorus —
In the quiet of Your presence, I find my breath again,
Breaking bread beside You, where the wounds all mend.
Your hands restore my heart, Your love makes me whole—
A desirable union, Lord, the keeper of my soul.
